correctness.rationale: The structural recurrence for trivially perfect graphs is exact: connected n-vertex graphs arise by adding a universal vertex, D=Q+z(1+z)^{n−1} for Q in all P_{n−1}; disconnected graphs are products of connected-component polynomials. Discarding multiplicities is valid for polynomial-image claims. INDEPENDENT ALTERNATIVE dynamic program constructs disconnected polynomial images by convolution of C_k with P_{n−k}, instead of source unordered partitions. It gives distinct P_n counts for n=2..15 exactly [2,4,9,20,48,115,284,713,1821,4701,12283,32374,86063,230337], zero log-concavity failures, then among all 230337 distinct connected order-16 polynomials finds exactly one violation with vector (0,1,15,230,1205,3615,7378,11080,12735,11410,8005,4368,1820,560,120,16,1) and defect only (2,−5). Disconnected order-16 graphs factor into lower-order components, whose nonnegative gap-free log-concave sequences remain so under convolution, excluding additional failures. Windmill W_{3,5} yields this vector from z(1+z)^15+((1+z)^5−1)^3 and direct vertex subsets; d2²−d1 d3=−5. The inequality for W_{3,m} fails precisely if 2m²>9m+3, i.e., integers m≥5; m≤4 covered by n≤13. The unique failure remains unimodal, hence all n≤16 unimodal. Computation establishes only stated finite cutoff, not all-order LC.

originality.rationale: This is NOT a claim of a new generalized-friendship/windmill polynomial: Rather 2025 Theorems 2.10 and 2.16 already give it, and the easy W_{3,5} negative defect follows. The new content is the sharp universal cutoff across *all* trivially perfect/quasi-threshold graphs and uniqueness of the order-16 coefficient vector, obtained by complete structural polynomial image enumeration. Omar 2026 addresses threshold graphs (proper subclass) and does not prove this entire trivially perfect sharp boundary. No Resultary hit covered the entire all-graphs n≤15 census. Possible unindexed enumeration under quasi-threshold terminology remains a risk.
residual_risks: Only a finite cutoff and one infinite windmill family are proved; no complete all-orders characterization.
The graph itself is not proven unique up to isomorphism at 16, only the domination coefficient vector is.
An unindexed quasi-threshold domination polynomial database may contain the same census.
Independent enumeration relies on correct implementation of an exact mathematically justified graph-class recurrence; arithmetic alone cannot certify class closure.

value.rationale: A globally sharp onset of failure of a natural coefficient regularity property in a hereditary graph class is a motivated exact finite structural boundary, especially because previous positive results for threshold graphs do not extend without limit and the first obstruction appears in a small natural windmill. The unique polynomial obstruction and full unimodality through the boundary are independently useful facts, beyond merely recomputing a known graph's formula.
